title: CIA-UAP-015, Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14 (Analysis of Reports of Unidentified Aerial Objects)
doc_notes: This document is a declassified CIA/Air Force technical report (Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14) analyzing UAP sighting statistics, and it contains a brief historical mention of the Kenneth Arnold encounter. / This is a declassified CIA Project Blue Book Special Report (No. 14) analyzing UAP sightings, and it contains detailed summaries of 12 'good UNKNOWN' encounters. / This document is a statistical analysis report (Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14) containing numerous tables of UAP sighting evaluations, but it does not contain any specific narrative encounter reports. / This document is a statistical analysis report (Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14) containing numerous tables of UAP sighting evaluations, but it does not contain narrative descriptions of specific encounters. / This is a declassified CIA Project Blue Book Special Report containing statistical tables of UAP sightings; it does not contain specific narrative encounter reports. / This document is a statistical analysis report (Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14) containing various tables and data collection forms, but it does not contain any specific narrative encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Kenneth Arnold reported a chainlike formation of disc-shaped objects near Mount Rainier, Washington.
Two men in a rug-cleaning firm saw a shiny, metallic object glide across a road and descend into a wooded area.
encounters.quote: shiny and metallic in construction, about 6 to 8 feet long and 2 feet wide

encounters.summary: A naval aviation student and others saw multiple groups of objects flying over a drive-in movie theater.
encounters.quote: each had a red glow surrounding it and was glowing itself

encounters.summary: Tower operators and pilots observed a cigar-shaped object with straight wings and no engine nacelles flying near a commercial plane.
encounters.quote: like an airplane with a cigar-shaped body and straight wings

encounters.summary: A farmer and hired hand observed two cigar-shaped objects, one hovering and one moving, which then ascended.
encounters.quote: appeared to be transparent and illuminated from the inside

encounters.summary: Pilot and copilot observed an object with two rows of lighted windows and a trail of fire passing their DC-3.
An instrument technician observed an object that moved in spurts, rolled to show a red side, and darted back and forth.
encounters.quote: darted back and forth, left and right alternately

encounters.summary: A Flight Sergeant observed an object performing spinning and tumbling maneuvers near the sun.
encounters.quote: flew in a series of spinning and tumbling actions

encounters.summary: An electrician and his wife observed an object flying on a straight and level course.
encounters.quote: flew on a straight and level course from horizon to horizon

encounters.summary: A farmer and his sons observed a sky-blue object hedge-hopping and agitating trees.
encounters.quote: trees were highly agitated by the craft as it passed over

encounters.summary: Laboratory employees observed a metallic object with a dirty skin moving at increasing speed.
encounters.quote: metallic construction and was seen with good enough resolution to show that the skin was dirty

encounters.summary: Two pilots observed a disc-shaped object with portholes and a brilliant blinking light.
encounters.quote: disc-like shape... 9 to 12 symmetrical oval or circular portholes

encounters.summary: A musician observed a hovering object with propellers and a visible occupant.
encounters.entity_appearance: head and shoulders of one man, sitting motionless
encounters.quote: head and shoulders of one man, sitting motionless, facing the forward edge of the object

encounters.summary: Analysis of reports of unidentified aerial objects, including statistical breakdowns of sightings by evaluation category and year.
encounters.quote: Analysis of Reports of Unidentified Aerial Objects
